in_sanskrit.name: Ayanman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Cosmos
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayanman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayanman is a Sanskrit name derived from the roots 'Ayam' (lord) and 'Manas' (mind or cosmos). This name signifies the supreme lord of the cosmos, who is the ruler of both the physical and the mental realms. It is believed that Ayanman is the embodiment of wisdom, power, and consciousness.
